LanChat is an Android app for chatting between nearby phones with no internet, router or account. This is an early preview.

**What has been checked:** 29 JVM unit tests pass and the debug build compiles in CI. This APK is built by GitHub Actions from the tagged commit. Nothing has been tested across real devices, and mesh range, voice call quality and battery use are not measured.

**Security:** direct chats and private groups are encrypted with AES-GCM. The public Nearby Mesh broadcast channel is not end-to-end encrypted: its text is only Base64-encoded, so anyone in range can read it. The encryption design has not been independently reviewed, and identity keys are stored in the app private storage, not yet wrapped by the Android Keystore. Do not rely on it where your safety depends on it.

**Requirements:** Android with Google Play Services (it uses Google Nearby Connections), Bluetooth, Nearby Wi-Fi, camera and microphone permissions.

**Install:** download the APK below and allow installs from your browser or file manager. Android will warn you because it is not from Google Play. The APK is signed with the project's own key. Signing certificate SHA-256:
`6B:5A:71:95:01:A3:D7:8F:0A:7F:EE:BF:60:88:CC:AF:C5:5F:1F:C0:66:66:F0:91:FD:56:B6:55:76:E3:E5:F4`

Please report problems as issues, with your phone model and Android version.
